Store kstitch CCA results in a Seurat object

Source: R/seurat_storage.r
store_kstitch_results.Rd

Takes the list returned by link_shape_and_factors and writes results into the Seurat object in two places:

  1. CSP and CEP scores are written into object-spanning DimReduc slots named <reduction_name>_csp and <reduction_name>_cep. Cells in the object that were not present in the CCA (e.g. cells excluded due to missing shape polygons) receive NA scores.

  2. All other fit information is written to obj@misc$kstitch[[reduction_name]].

store_kstitch_results(
  obj,
  result,
  reduction_name = "kstitch",
  reduction_key_csp = "CSP_",
  reduction_key_cep = "CEP_"
)

Arguments

obj

A Seurat v5 object.

result

List as returned by link_shape_and_factors.

reduction_name

Character. Base name used to construct the DimReduc slot names (<reduction_name>_csp and <reduction_name>_cep) and the obj@misc$kstitch key. Must be unique across calls. Default "kstitch".

reduction_key_csp

Character. Key prefix for the CSP DimReduc. Default "CSP_".

reduction_key_cep

Character. Key prefix for the CEP DimReduc. Default "CEP_".

Value

The Seurat object with obj[["<reduction_name>_csp"]], obj[["<reduction_name>_cep"]], and obj@misc$kstitch[[reduction_name]] populated.

Details

To store multiple CCA results (e.g. cell vs nucleus, regressed vs unregressed, or different cell types), call this function once per result with a distinct reduction_name.

See also

link_shape_and_factors, get_kstitch_results
